item.title: How Lovable Migrated from Next.js to TanStack Start
item.description: 42M monthly visitors, 400 routes and 850K lines of code moved from Next.js on Vercel to TanStack Start on Lovable—route by route, mostly by agents, with one 11-minute incident along the way. (2 sources: javascriptweekly, reactstatus)

item.title: What We Learnt Building a Data Grid in React, Vue, and Svelte
item.description: We built the same data grid for React, Svelte, and Vue. Here's what we learned about performance, framework differences, and why the framework is the last thing you should blame when your app is slow. (2 sources: javascriptweekly, reactstatus)
